row.evidence: One Medical sells an employer-sponsored primary-care membership that employees activate themselves with a company code; its business, small-business, sponsored-membership and FAQ pages describe no SSO, SCIM or admin provisioning, and the sitemap has no such pages.
row.notes: New row. One Medical (Amazon One Medical) is a primary-care membership sold to employers as a benefit, not a seat-based admin product. Consumers pay $199/year; the small-business plan is 'discounted' with no listed price, and larger employers get enterprise solutions via sales. Employees activate a sponsored membership with a company code and sign in with their own One Medical or Login with Amazon credentials (consumer sign-in, not SAML). When an employee leaves, One Medical emails them that the sponsorship is ending; the eligibility mechanism behind that is not documented. The Okta catalogue entry is a 2015 password-vaulting (SWA) app. 'None' is by absence (rule 5); no developer or API documentation exists on the site.
